$comment: The machine-readable baseline. Each check names the tiers it applies to and the standard it enforces. drift-check.mjs implements every check marked automated; the rest are reviewed by hand. Tiers are defined in repository.md, rule 1.

checks.description: Every public, non-archived, non-fork repository is listed in repos.json with a tier.
Private vulnerability reporting is enabled.
Dependabot alerts are enabled.
Dependabot security updates are enabled.
Secret scanning and push protection are enabled.
The default GITHUB_TOKEN is read-only and Actions cannot approve pull requests.
The default branch uses rulesets, not classic branch protection.
An active ruleset on the default branch blocks deletion and force-push. Bypass actors are checked when the token can see them (GitHub shows them only to tokens with write access).
The default branch requires a pull request and status checks; at least one is reported by the GitHub Actions app (integration 15368), and every required check is pinned to the app that reports it.
An active tag ruleset covering refs/tags/v* (or ~ALL) blocks deletion, update and force-push. Bypass actors are checked when the token can see them.
A SECURITY.md applies (the repository's own, or the .github default), and it names no address outside contactDomains.
dependabot.yml covers every ecosystem present (bun for Bun projects, npm, cargo, gomod, pip/uv, github-actions) and every entry has cooldown default-days of at least 7.
RELEASING.md exists.
A repository with bun.lock has bunfig.toml with minimumReleaseAge of at least 7 days.
A Bun project sets trustedDependencies explicitly (empty or a justified list) or ignoreScripts, so Bun's built-in allow-list does not run install scripts.
No workflow is disabled (manually or for inactivity).
Every bun/pnpm install in a workflow uses --frozen-lockfile, and npm uses ci rather than install.
Some workflow audits dependencies (bun/pnpm/npm audit, cargo audit, rustsec/audit-check, cargo-deny, govulncheck). Whether it runs on pull requests as its own job is reviewed by hand.
zizmor reports no unignored findings above informational (run with --zizmor).
No open Dependabot pull request is older than staleDependabotDays.
No open Dependabot alert of high or critical severity.
No repository, Dependabot or environment secret looks like a long-lived token (names matching NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN, *_PAT, GH_PAT*, GH_TOKEN, *TAP_TOKEN*).
The job holding id-token: write installs and tests nothing; it publishes an artifact built by an earlier job.
Each npm package requires 2FA and disallows tokens; its trusted publisher is configured.
Each crate requires trusted publishing for all new versions.
devDependencies (and an application's dependencies) are exact versions, enforced in CI (syncpack lint or equivalent).
The audit runs on pull requests in its own job, at --audit-level=high.
The release checks the tag matches the manifest version, the commit is on main, and skips versions already published.
Binary releases publish checksums and run an attest job that verifies against them.
Formulae build from source, the tap CI is green, and no cask strips quarantine.
No npm dist-tag points at a version older than the latest patched release.
